what: Finding 1: ci-wait progress cannot be converted directly from larch_errf to emit_breadcrumb
scenario_or_breakage: emit_breadcrumb writes legacy text to stdout/current quiet log and adds newlines when LARCH_BREADCRUMB_STREAM is unset, so replacing larch_errf "." and status lines breaks the existing stderr dot-progress contract the plan says to preserve
suggested_fix: Add a ci-wait progress helper that calls emit_breadcrumb --category=wait-ci only when LARCH_BREADCRUMB_STREAM is set and otherwise calls larch_errf with the existing format strings; pin the unset stderr byte-for-byte behavior before changing callsites

what: Finding 2: larch-log has no safe source path for the actual breadcrumb streams
scenario_or_breakage: The launch blocks write streams under $IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs, while larch-log commit only knows $LARCH_LOG_ROOT/$SKILL/$RUN_ID and copies that tree to the repo; implementing the plan against src_path will silently miss breadcrumbs, while moving raw breadcrumbs under src_path risks cp -rp copying secrets before redaction or on redactor failure
suggested_fix: Define an explicit sanitized source contract, e.g. --breadcrumb-dir or a validated ${IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR,DESIGN_TMPDIR,REVIEW_TMPDIR}/breadcrumbs derivation, then stage redacted breadcrumbs into a temp repo run dir after excluding raw breadcrumbs from the broad copy; test both success and redactor-failure paths leave no raw repo files

what: Finding 3: the category migration misses sourced and child callsites that inherit the stream
scenario_or_breakage: ship-pr invokes implement-finalize while LARCH_BREADCRUMB_STREAM is exported, and review-and-fix sources review-implement-step5-loop in the streamed Step 5 path; their uncategorized emit_breadcrumb calls will log WARN unknown-category and be dropped from the live stream after this rollout
suggested_fix: Add --category mappings to implement-finalize.sh and review-implement-step5-loop.sh callsites that can run under an inherited stream, or deliberately unset LARCH_BREADCRUMB_STREAM around child calls if those breadcrumbs are intentionally not streamed and document that tradeoff

what: Finding 4: the batch-table test is not updated for the proposed breadcrumbs entry
scenario_or_breakage: Adding breadcrumbs/ to scripts/larch-log-batches.sh will fail the hardcoded expected batch list and the extension/sanitizer allowlists in test-larch-logs-batches.sh, but the plan only updates test-larch-log.sh
suggested_fix: Update test-larch-logs-batches.sh in the same change, including the expected slug list and any new directory/sanitizer vocabulary, or keep breadcrumbs out of the scalar batch table and document it as a commit-only artifact

what: Finding 5: the proposed path-scope test would continue excluding an existing documented research breadcrumb root
scenario_or_breakage: Research-phase docs launch collect-agent-results with streams under RESEARCH_TMPDIR, but breadcrumb-monitor currently only accepts IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR, DESIGN_TMPDIR, and REVIEW_TMPDIR; codifying path-scope rejection without RESEARCH_TMPDIR keeps that workflow broken
suggested_fix: Add RESEARCH_TMPDIR to the allowed session roots and include it in the path-scope tests, or update the research docs to use a supported tmpdir before making the rejection contract stricter
